test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 11 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In which year was the Jammu and Kashmir Legislative Council abolished?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2019**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Jammu and Kashmir Legislative Council**:-

 
 
• The first constituent assembly of J&K came into being in 1957.
 
• **Composition of Legislative Council:**-​
 
 
• The size should not be more than one-third of the membership of the state legislative assembly.
 
• Also, the size should be not less than 40 members.
 
 
 
• Article 169 of the Indian Constitution provides a provision for the creation or abolition of a legislative council.
 
• The action was taken place after the introduction of the Jammu and Kashmir State Reorganization Bill, 2019.
 
 
 
 
 
 
• ​Jammu and Kashmir State Reorganization Bill (2019):- 
 
 
• This bill reorganized the state of Jammu and Kashmir into the Union territory of Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Some states have **bicameral state legislature**;

 
 
• The **lower house** is State Assembly
 
• The **upper house** is the State Legislative Council.
 
 
 
• Currently, 6 states have Legislative Council namely, Karnataka, Uttar Pradesh, Maharashtra, Bihar, Andhra Pradesh, and Telangana.
